method: Schedule-based congestion proxy: ZTM timetable running times of buses and trams on one weekday; scheduled speed per consecutive stop pair and hour, measured over a window of +-2 stops to beat minute rounding (sum of shape distance / sum of scheduled time, >=2 trips), congestion = 1 - speed_h / max hourly speed of that segment; segments map-matched to road centre lines (<=25 m, direction <35 deg, >=15 m overlap), per way weighted by overlap x trips. null = no transit on that way or too few trips in that hour. This is ZTM's planned slowdown, not live traffic.
source: ZTM Warszawa GTFS via mkuran.pl (https://mkuran.pl/gtfs/warsaw.zip), feed 2026-10-17 00:15:22; road geometry © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)
